1. Check `next_fix.md` report for systemic patterns
2. Review if macro_alpha module can be stabilized (address the 0.05 tuning min)
3. Consider whether lockbox_min improvement warrants a hybrid approach

System is functioning nominally. No intervention needed before runloop completion.
